disclaimer: This information is for clinical decision-support and educational guidance only. It does not constitute a definitive medical diagnosis or replace consultation with a licensed medical practitioner.

sources.title: Integrated Management of Neonatal and Childhood Illness (IMNCI) Guidelines
sources.authority: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW), Govt. of India & WHO/UNICEF
sources.key_recommendation: Children under 5 years with high fever (>3 days), inability to drink or breastfeed, or lethargy must be assessed immediately at a Primary Health Centre (PHC) for dehydration and febrile infection management.

sources.title: National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme - Clinical Management of Dengue and Malaria
sources.authority: Directorate General of Health Services, MoHFW, Govt. of India
sources.key_recommendation: Acute febrile illness with severe headache, retro-orbital pain, or joint pain during monsoon/post-monsoon requires NS1/IgM antigen and platelet monitoring at a registered laboratory. Never self-medicate with NSAIDs like ibuprofen/aspirin; consult a physician.

sources.title: National Programme for Prevention & Control of Non-Communicable Diseases (NP-NCD)
sources.authority: National Health Mission (NHM), Govt. of India
sources.key_recommendation: Blood pressure persistently above 140/90 mmHg or fasting blood glucose above 126 mg/dL warrants baseline screening by a Medical Officer at an Arogya Mandir / PHC.

sources.title: National Tele-Mental Health Programme (Tele-MANAS)
sources.key_recommendation: 24x7 toll-free mental health psychosocial support available across India in multiple languages via 14416 or 1800-891-4416.

specialties.name: General Physician / Family Medicine
specialties.scope: First point of contact for acute fevers, respiratory infections, gastrointestinal distress, preventative health check-ups, and baseline chronic disease management.
specialties.when_to_visit: Persistent cold, fever lasting more than 48 hours, body aches, digestive upset, or unexplained fatigue.

specialties.name: Pediatrics & Child Health
specialties.scope: Care for infants, young children, and adolescents under 16 years, covering immunization schedules, febrile seizures, developmental milestones, and IMNCI triage.
specialties.when_to_visit: Infants under 3 months with fever, refusal to feed, grunting or rapid breathing, or lethargy in children.

specialties.name: Cardiology & Emergency Internal Medicine
specialties.qualifications: DM / DNB Cardiology, MD Emergency Medicine
specialties.scope: Acute coronary syndromes, hypertension crises, arrhythmias, heart failure, and cardiovascular risk reduction.
specialties.when_to_visit: Severe chest pain radiating to the left arm or jaw, sudden shortness of breath with cold sweat, palpitations, or syncope (call 108/112 immediately).

specialties.name: Obstetrics & Maternal Health
specialties.scope: Antenatal care (ANC), delivery management, gestational diabetes, pre-eclampsia screening, and postpartum monitoring.
specialties.when_to_visit: Pregnancy follow-ups, severe abdominal cramps during pregnancy, excessive swelling of feet, or high BP during gestation.
